verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud's pricing page says users can set compute autoscaling limits specifically to stop runaway queries from producing unexpected bills. Autoscaling and scale-to-zero further limit idle and overprovisioned spend. This caps compute indirectly but is not a dollar spend cap, and there is no evidence of usage or billing alerts. Missing for 10: hard dollar spend caps, usage/billing alert notifications, in-depth docs on configuring limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
